profile.name: King
profile.overview: King is Tekken's iconic implementation of a grappler, having access to a wide variety of very strong and very useful throws.
profile.playstyle: The grappler. Wavu calls his throw game the strongest of all: make the opponent block, then throw them with command throws that each break differently. Mix throws with mids and lows so they cannot just duck or break. His big body, slow movement and weak panic options make defence hard, so take the initiative.
strengths: Suplex City: Strongest throw game among all characters, with all the mixup potential and damage one can ask for.
Backstage Brawler: Devastating mids like uf+4, db+2, f+4, f+2,1, and f,F+1 compliment his throws, punishing those who prefer to duck throws instead of breaking them.
Tank: Very abusable power crushing moves. Muscle Armor also comes out 1f faster than usual, allowing for retaliation where typical power crushes may not work.
Turn Stealer: Great CH tools like b+1,2 and df+2,1. He also possesses a faster than average low crush with JGS.

AS GOD IS MY WITNESS, HE IS BROKEN IN HALF: Heat makes his JGR fully armored and JGR moves perform better. His Heat Smash deals the most damage in the game, and can even hit grounded opponents & break hard floors for a full combo.
weaknesses: The Big Show: Large hurtbox with below average movement, and his backdash cancel is awkwardly slow.
Remain Calm: Panic moves are quite risky.
Worked Into a Shoot: Whiff recovery is quite prominent.

stances.name: Jaguar Step
stances.entry: From dashes and transitions (see the Move Library)
stances.note: JGR.1+3 is an unbreakable throw and Heat Engager; in Heat Jaguar Step becomes armoured and its moves are powered up (Wavu).

heat: Certain throws become homing (WR2+4, f,hcf+1, f,hcf+2, qcb+1+2)
JGR moves are powered up (JGR.1, JGR.2, JGR.3, JGR.4)

sources.note: Community-maintained frame data. Values can lag behind the latest patch; verify in Practice mode frame display.

keyMoves.use: To make crouchers respect mids before you throw.
keyMoves.gamePlan: Mid check that sets up throws.

keyMoves.summary: Body Check: i17 mid, +3 on block.
keyMoves.purpose: A plus mid that keeps the turn.
keyMoves.use: To keep pressure before a throw.

keyMoves.summary: Jumping Knee Lift: i15 launcher, -13 on block.
keyMoves.use: After -15 moves and to whiff punish.

keyMoves.summary: Toe Smash: i11 while-standing kick, -6 on block.
Snap Uppercut: i18 while-standing launcher, -10 on block.
keyMoves.use: After lows that are -18 or worse.

keyMoves.summary: Leg Breaker: i32 low that instantly tornadoes, -12 on block.
keyMoves.use: As a read on standing block.
keyMoves.counterplay: Block low; it is slow enough to react.

keyMoves.summary: Shoulder Tackle: i20 mid Heat Engager, -5 on block.
Giant Swing: i10 command throw, break with 1, side switch.
keyMoves.purpose: A big-damage command throw (homing in Heat).

keyMoves.summary: Tijuana Twister: i12 command throw, break with 2.
Muscle Buster: i11 command throw, break with 1+2, side switch.
Tomahawk: i10 throw from a run, break with 1+2.
keyMoves.purpose: A fast running throw (homing in Heat).
keyMoves.use: To catch the opponent from a dash.

combos.name: Launch BnB: 4 b+3 T! f,f,F+2+4
combos.situation: After a regular launch such as uf+4.
mistakes: Running too late for the Tomahawk ender.
